prerequisites: Python 3.8+ and a shell. A virtual environment keeps the selected Ledger executable explicit.

capabilities.title: Tasks and dependencies
capabilities.summary: Keep task intent, status, blockers and responses in Git-native records.
details: Use create, list, search, get, update and mark for the legacy flat task interface. Native Records also provide a typed task profile.
Dependencies must be explicit: ready finds unblocked work and order sorts dependencies. Cycles and invalid completed-task transitions fail before writes.
Use body-file and response-file transport for rich Markdown; do not hand-edit the store.
commands:
yylo-ledger create --title "Verify onboarding" --body "Run the documented quick start" --tags onboarding
yylo-ledger list --limit 5 --format table
yylo-ledger ready
yylo-ledger doctor
capabilities.boundary: Ledger records work; it does not own coding-agent execution or Git integration.
capabilities.releaseEvidence: README sections matching this capability, inspected in the hash-bound published archive.

capabilities.title: Native Records: wiki, workflow and artifacts
capabilities.summary: Use immutable IDs and revision-safe updates for durable engineering memory.
details: Wiki stores Markdown knowledge. Workflow stores validated definitions but does not execute them. Artifacts retain provenance and intentional payload modes.
General Records and typed profiles share ID-first discovery. Aliases resolve to an immutable ID; updates use revision/preimage controls.
Search is bounded by count and bytes. Summary excludes payload bytes; full output is an explicit audited choice. Sensitive records expose safe identity metadata.
commands:
yylo-ledger wiki --help
yylo-ledger workflow --help
yylo-ledger artifact --help
yylo-ledger record search --scope all --profile wiki --projection summary --limit 20 --format json
capabilities.boundary: Storage, workflow execution and evidence retention remain separate authorities.
capabilities.releaseEvidence: README sections matching this capability, inspected in the hash-bound published archive.

capabilities.title: Read-only Record host
capabilities.summary: Serve bounded local views without exposing a mutation API.
details: The host exposes record, history, wiki, workflow and artifact routes. Loopback is the default.
Non-loopback access requires an explicit private policy. External artifact redirects require approved HTTPS hosts; traversal and unsafe redirects fail closed.
capabilities.boundary: No write, workflow-execution or arbitrary remote-fetch API.
capabilities.releaseEvidence: README sections matching this capability, inspected in the hash-bound published archive.

capabilities.title: Preservation-first migration
capabilities.summary: Copy legacy knowledge into Records without deleting original files.
details: Inventory, plan, apply, status and verify use explicit receipts outside the source root. Review the plan before apply.
Plans bind source bytes, destination, runtime and record identities. Drift fails closed. Retries reuse only matching migration provenance.
commands:
yylo-ledger migration inventory --help
yylo-ledger migration plan --help
yylo-ledger migration apply --help
capabilities.boundary: Migration is not cleanup: source deletion is never performed.
capabilities.releaseEvidence: README sections matching this capability, inspected in the hash-bound published archive.

capabilities.title: History and cold archives
capabilities.summary: Keep current state and append-only history separate.
details: Markdown and segmented ledgers are canonical. SQLite is a rebuildable query cache. Default discovery reads hot work; exact ID lookups can resolve verified cold packs.
Archive-pack planning and creation are separate, revision-bound owner operations requiring clean state and external receipts. Follow up with a new related task rather than reopening a cold ID.
commands:
yylo-ledger history TASK_ID --limit 20
yylo-ledger archive-pack plan --help
yylo-ledger archive-search --limit 20 --projection metadata
capabilities.boundary: Never edit sealed packs or automate destructive archival.
capabilities.releaseEvidence: README sections matching this capability, inspected in the hash-bound published archive.

capabilities.title: Install the four Ledger skills
capabilities.summary: Use task, wiki, workflow and artifact procedures without installing YYLO CLI.
details: The targeted installer stages and validates exactly four canonical skills. It tries the open Skills CLI before an exact-tag Git fallback.
Custom and unrelated skills are preserved. Install/update are explicit network operations; list/status and normal Ledger commands stay offline.
commands:
yylo-ledger skills install
yylo-ledger skills status
capabilities.boundary: Planning and bounded-delivery skills rely on YYLO orchestration, not standalone Ledger.
capabilities.releaseEvidence: README sections matching this capability, inspected in the hash-bound published archive.

capabilities.title: Cross-project routing and machine output
capabilities.summary: Make destination and output projection explicit.
details: Project routing is opt-in and allowlisted. Invalid or stale routes never silently fall back to the source board.
Use JSON, NDJSON, XML or table output. Request bounded projections rather than dumping all payloads.
commands:
yylo-ledger project --help
yylo-ledger search --status todo --format json
capabilities.boundary: The destination wrapper and policy remain authoritative.
